clips.title: The story
paras: At the Valley of Trials, Ukor's food is turned away, and he needs help bringing it back to Razor Hill.

Ukor, an orc peon, rarely acts on his own, but he carried provisions from the inn in Razor Hill to help young recruits in the Valley of Trials. The journey led him through Durotar's red dust and dangerous wildlife. The overseers and instructors refused the food, believing hardship and hunger make true warriors. Now Ukor waits outside the canyon's mouth, afraid of the beasts along the trail back. He has entrusted the sack to passing travelers, asking them to return it to Innkeeper Grosk.
